// Dev-only comparison fixture: visual control states, never game progression.
import { h } from "/src/ui/dom.ts";
import { icon } from "/src/ui/skin.ts";
export const FOUNDATION_STATES = [
	"default",
	"hover",
	"pressed",
	"selected",
	"focus",
	"disabled",
	"locked",
	"busy",
	"error"
];
export function designSystemBoard() {
	const board = h("main", { class: "foundation-board" });
	board.append(h(
		"h1",
		null,
		/* copy:label */
		"Idlever controls"
	), h(
		"p",
		null,
		/* copy:label */
		"Design fixture"
	));
	for (const material of [
		"forge",
		"bloodlines",
		"journal"
	]) {
		const section = h("section", {
			class: "ui-material foundation-material",
			"data-material": material
		}, h("h2", null, material));
		for (const state of FOUNDATION_STATES) {
			const unavailable = state === "disabled" || state === "locked";
			const cell = h("article", {
				class: "foundation-cell",
				"data-cell": `${material}-${state}`
			}, h("b", null, state));
			const label = state === "locked" ? "Locked · requirement" : state === "busy" ? "Preparing…" : state === "error" ? "Try again" : state === "selected" ? "✓ Selected" : /* copy:button */ "Inspect upgrade";
			const button = h("button", {
				class: "ui-action",
				"data-state": state,
				disabled: unavailable,
				"aria-busy": state === "busy" ? "true" : "false",
				"aria-pressed": state === "selected" ? "true" : "false"
			}, state === "locked" ? icon("lock", "🔒") : null, label);
			cell.append(button, h("small", null, unavailable ? "Requires discovery" : state === "error" ? "Request failed" : state === "busy" ? "Request pending" : /* copy:tooltip */ "Alistair Moonwake the Unbroken · Gold 1,234,567"));
			section.append(cell);
		}
		board.append(section);
	}
	return board;
}
